records.literal_gloss: To [the] Lord our God [belong] the compassions and the forgivenesses, for we have rebelled against him,

en.L: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}
en.B: But the Lord our God is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, Lord our God, are kind and forgiving, even though we have turned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

pt.L: Ao Senhor nosso Deus [pertencem] as misericórdias e os perdões, pois nos rebelamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}
pt.B: Mas o Senhor nosso Deus tem compaixão e perdoa, embora nos tenhamos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, Senhor nosso Deus, és bondoso e perdoas, mesmo que nós tenhamos nos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Au Seigneur notre Dieu les compassions et les pardons, car nous nous sommes révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}
fr.B: Mais le Seigneur notre Dieu est plein de compassion et de pardon, bien que nous nous soyons révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur notre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es bon et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pardonnes, même si nous nous sommes révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

es.L: Al Señor nuestro Dios [pertenecen] la compasión y el perdón, porque nos hemos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}
es.B: Pero el Señor nuestro Dios es compasivo y perdonador, aunque nos hemos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, Señor nuestro Dios, eres compasivo y perdonas, aunque nos hemos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

sw.L: Kwa Bwana Mungu wetu [ni] huruma na msamaha, kwa maana tumemwasi
sw.B: Lakini Bwana Mungu wetu ni mwenye huruma na msamaha, ingawa tumemwasi.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Bwana Mungu wetu, u mwenye huruma na husamehe, ingawa tumekuasi.

vi.L: Thuộc về Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con là lòng thương xót và sự tha thứ, vì chúng con đã phản nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}
vi.B: Nhưng Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con đầy lòng thương xót và sẵn lòng tha thứ, dù chúng con đã phản nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng lạy Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhân từ và hay tha thứ, dù chúng con đã chống nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주 저희 하나님께는 긍휼과 용서가 [있습니다]. 참으로 저희가 그분께 반역하였고
ko.B: 그러나 주 저희 하나님께서는 긍휼이 많으시고 용서하시는 분이십니다. 저희가 그분께 반역했는데도 그러하십니다.
ko.R: 그러나 주 저희 하나님, 주님은 자비로우시고 저희를 용서해 주십니다. 저희가 주님께 반역했는데도 그렇게 하십니다.

am.L: በእርሱ ላይ ዐምፀናልና ምሕረትና ይቅርታ ለአምላካችን ለጌታ ነው፤
am.B: በእርሱ ላይ ብናምፅም ጌታ አምላካችን መሐሪና ይቅር ባይ ነው።
am.R: ጌታ አምላካችን ሆይ፣ በአንተ ላይ ብናምፅም አንተ ርኅሩኅና ይቅር ባይ ነህ።

hi.L: प्रभु हमारे परमेश्वर ही दयालु और क्षमा करनेवाले हैं, क्योंकि हमने उनके विरुद्ध विद्रोह किया है
hi.B: पर प्रभु हमारे परमेश्वर दयालु और क्षमा करनेवाले हैं, यद्यपि हमने उनके विरुद्ध विद्रोह किया है।
hi.R: पर हे प्रभु हमारे परमेश्वर, तू दयालु है और क्षमा करता है, यद्यपि हम तेरे विरुद्ध हो गए हैं।

ru.L: У Господа, Бога нашего, — милосердие и прощение, потому что мы восстали против {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}
ru.B: Но Господь, наш Бог, милосерден и прощает, хотя мы и восстали против {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, Господи, наш Бог, добр и прощаешь, хотя мы и восстали против {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.

ja.L: あわれみと赦しは、わたしたちの神である主のものです。わたしたちはその方に背きました。
ja.B: わたしたちはその方に背いたのに、わたしたちの神である主は、あわれみ深く、赦してくださる方です。
ja.R: わたしたちはあなたに逆らいましたが、わたしたちの神である主よ、あなたは優しく、ゆるしてくださる方です。

decisions.choice: for we have rebelled: though, or because, we have rebelled
decisions.reason: The small word that joins the clauses can mean "for" or "though". God's compassion and forgiveness are all the more needed, and all the more great, because the people have rebelled.

decisions.choice: compassion and forgiveness: both plural in the Hebrew
decisions.reason: Both words are plural, a way of speaking of abundant mercy and many acts of forgiveness (Nehemiah 9:17, "a God of forgivenesses"; Psalm 130:4).

decisions.choice: no closing punctuation at the end of the verse (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence runs into verse 10, and Literal joins them with no full stop.

decisions.choice: you, Lord our God (R)
decisions.reason: Daniel speaks about God here in the third person, as in verses 10-14, though he is praying to him. Readable turns it to "you" so that it is clear Daniel is still speaking to God; Literal and Balanced keep "him". The pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting at every level.

decisions.choice: "les compassions et les pardons" (L), both plural as in the Hebrew
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew plurals the meaning decision notes; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary singular or a verb.

decisions.choice: Literal leaves the sentence open at the end of the verse ("반역하였고"), as the English does, and verse 10 finishes it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs on from "we have rebelled" into "and we have not listened"; each verse keeps its own words.

decisions.choice: "긍휼과 용서" (L, B); "자비로우시고 … 용서해 주십니다" (R)
decisions.reason: Rachamim is "긍휼" at Literal and Balanced and "자비" at Readable, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: no closing punctuation at the end of the verse (L)
decisions.reason: As the English L: the sentence goes on into verse 10

decisions.choice: "हे प्रभु हमारे परमेश्वर, तू" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Daniel speaks of God here in the third person, though he is praying to him; Literal and Balanced keep it, with the honorific (उनके). Readable turns it to तू so that it is clear Daniel is still speaking to God, as the English Readable does in verses 9-12.

decisions.choice: no closing punctuation (Literal)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence runs into verse 10, and Literal joins them with no full stop, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "あわれみと赦し" (L), "あわれみ深く、赦してくださる" (B), "優しく、ゆるしてくださる" (R); ki as two sentences (L), "…のに" (B), "…が" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal leaves open whether the rebellion is the reason or the contrast (m1); Balanced and Readable read it as "even though", as the English. Forgive "赦す" (L, B), "ゆるす" (R) as the style guide.

source.text: וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּתֽוֹרֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣ן לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and not we have listened to [the] voice of Yahweh our God, to walk in his instructions which he set before us by [the] hand of his servants the prophets.

en.L: and we have not listened to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, to walk in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} instructions which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set before us by the hand of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets.
en.B: We have not obeyed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God or lived by the instructions {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set before us through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets.
en.R: We have not obeyed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God. We have not lived by the teachings {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave us through {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants the prophets.

pt.L: e não ouvimos a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, nosso Deus, para andar nas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} instruções, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pôs diante de nós pela mão dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, os profetas.
pt.B: Não obedecemos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, nosso Deus, nem vivemos segundo as instruções que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pôs diante de nós por meio dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, os profetas.
pt.R: Não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} obedecemos, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus. Não vivemos de acordo com os ensinamentos que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nos deste por meio dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} servos, os profetas.

fr.L: et nous n’avons pas écouté la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, pour marcher dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} instructions qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mises devant nous par la main de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes.
fr.B: Nous n’avons pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} notre Dieu, et nous n’avons pas suivi les instructions qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a données par {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes.
fr.R: Nous ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons pas obéi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu. Nous n’avons pas vécu selon les enseignements que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous as donnés par {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs les prophètes.

es.L: y no hemos escuchado la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, para andar en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} instrucciones, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso delante de nosotros por mano de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas.
es.B: No hemos obedecido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios ni hemos vivido conforme a las instrucciones que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso delante de nosotros por medio de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas.
es.R: No {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hemos obedecido, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios. No hemos vivido según las enseñanzas que nos diste por medio de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos los profetas.

sw.L: wala hatukuisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, kwenda katika sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} alizoziweka mbele yetu kwa mkono wa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} manabii.
sw.B: Hatukumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu wala kuishi kwa mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} aliyoyaweka mbele yetu kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} manabii.
sw.R: Hatukukutii {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu. Hatukuishi kwa mafundisho uliyotupa kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} manabii.

vi.L: và chúng con đã không nghe tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, để bước đi trong những lời chỉ dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt trước mặt chúng con qua tay các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri.
vi.B: Chúng con đã không vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, cũng không sống theo những lời chỉ dạy mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt trước mặt chúng con qua các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri.
vi.R: Chúng con đã không vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con. Chúng con đã không sống theo những lời dạy dỗ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho chúng con qua các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri.

ko.L: 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 듣지 않았으며, 그분께서 그분의 종 예언자들의 손으로 저희 앞에 두신 그분의 가르침들 안에서 행하지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 저희는 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종하지 않았고, 그분께서 그분의 종 예언자들을 통하여 저희 앞에 주신 가르침대로 살지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 저희는 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 주님께 순종하지 않았습니다. 주님께서 주님의 종 예언자들을 통하여 주신 가르침대로 살지 않았습니다.

am.L: በባሪያዎቹ በነቢያት እጅ በፊታችን ባኖረው ትምህርቱ እንሄድ ዘንድ የአምላካችንን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ድምፅ አልሰማንም።
am.B: አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አልታዘዝንም፤ በአገልጋዮቹ በነቢያት በኩል በፊታችን ባኖረው ትምህርትም አልኖርንም።
am.R: አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተን አልታዘዝንም። በአገልጋዮችህ በነቢያት በኩል በሰጠኸን ትምህርት አልኖርንም።

hi.L: और हमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की बात नहीं सुनी, कि उनकी व्यवस्थाओं पर चलें जो उन्होंने अपने दास भविष्यद्वक्ताओं के हाथ से हमारे सामने रखीं।
hi.B: हमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की आज्ञा नहीं मानी, और न उस व्यवस्था के अनुसार चले जो उन्होंने अपने दास भविष्यद्वक्ताओं के द्वारा हमारे सामने रखी थी।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर, हमने तेरी आज्ञा नहीं मानी। हम उन शिक्षाओं के अनुसार नहीं चले जो तूने अपने दास नबियों के द्वारा हमें दी थीं।

ru.L: и мы не слушали голоса {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, чтобы ходить в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} наставлениях, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} положил перед нами рукой своих рабов, пророков.
ru.B: Мы не послушались {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, и не жили по наставлениям, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал нам через своих рабов, пророков.
ru.R: Мы не послушались {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога. Мы не жили по наставлениям, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} дал нам через {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} рабов, пророков.

ja.L: わたしたちは、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声に聞き従わず、その方が、そのしもべである預言者たちの手によって、わたしたちの前に置かれた教えに歩みませんでした。
ja.B: わたしたちは、わたしたちの神である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に聞き従わず、その方がしもべである預言者たちを通して示された教えに従って歩みませんでした。
ja.R: わたしたちの神である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしたちはあなたに従いませんでした。あなたが、しもべである預言者たちを通して与えてくださった教えのとおりに生きてきませんでした。

decisions.choice: listened to the voice: obeyed
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice is to obey them (Deuteronomy 13:5; Jeremiah 7:23).

decisions.choice: instructions: God's teachings, the torah
decisions.reason: The plural of the word torah means God's instructions or laws (Exodus 18:16, 20; Jeremiah 44:23). "By the hand of" means through the prophets as his messengers.

decisions.choice: instructions (L, B); teachings (R)
decisions.reason: Torah follows the Isaiah table, "instruction" and "teaching", in the plural here. Readable turns the third person to "you", as in verse 9.

decisions.choice: "instructions" (L, B), "enseignements" (R) for God's torot here
decisions.reason: The plural names the teachings given through the prophets; "instructions" and "enseignements" are the term sheet's words for God's torah at Balanced and Readable, and Literal follows the English, which says "instructions" there too.

decisions.choice: "sheria" (L); "mafundisho" (B, R) for God's torot here; "sheria" at every level for "your law" and "the law of Moses" (9:11, 13)
decisions.reason: The torah rule of the Isaiah-Jeremiah term sheet (sheria at L, mafundisho at B and R). Where the text names the written law of Moses, every level says "sheria", as the English says "law" at every level.

decisions.choice: "những lời chỉ dạy" (L, B); "những lời dạy dỗ" (R) for torot
decisions.reason: The plural torot here are God's instructions given through the prophets; "luật pháp" is kept for "the law of Moses" in verses 11 and 13, as the English keeps "law" there.

decisions.choice: "가르침" for torot at every level
decisions.reason: As the English says "instructions" and as Jeremiah 31:33 renders torah; "율법" stays for the law of Moses in verses 11 and 13.

decisions.choice: "instrucciones" (L, B); "enseñanzas" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for torah as God's teaching (instrucción / enseñanza)

decisions.choice: "व्यवस्थाओं" (Literal); "व्यवस्था" (Balanced); "शिक्षाओं" (Readable)
decisions.reason: God's torah is "व्यवस्था" at Literal and Balanced and "शिक्षा" at Readable, as the poetry note has it; Literal keeps the Hebrew plural. Balanced and Readable say "obey" for "listen to the voice" (m1), and Readable turns to "you" as in verse 9.

decisions.choice: наставления
decisions.reason: The plural of torah here is God's teachings given through the prophets (m2); "наставления" at every level, kept apart from "Закон Моисея" in verse 11.

decisions.choice: torot "教え" at every level
decisions.reason: God's teachings (m2), kept apart from "律法" for torah as the written law of Moses in 9:11, 9:13.

source.text: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עָֽבְרוּ֙ אֶת־תּ֣וֹרָתֶ֔ךָ וְס֕וֹר לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּקֹלֶ֑ךָ וַתִּתַּ֨ךְ עָלֵ֜ינוּ הָאָלָ֣ה וְהַשְּׁבֻעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר כְּתוּבָה֙ בְּתוֹרַת֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And all Israel have transgressed your law and turned aside, not to listen to your voice; and has been poured on us the curse and the oath which [is] written in [the] law of Moses the servant of God, for we have sinned against him.

en.L: And all Israel has transgressed {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} law and turned aside, not listening to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} voice; so the curse and the oath that are written in the law of Moses the servant of God have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: All Israel has broken {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} law and turned away, refusing to obey {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. So the curse and the oath that are written in the law of Moses, the servant of God, have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: All the people of Israel have broken {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} law and turned away. They have refused to obey {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. So the curses that are written in the law of Moses, God's servant, have been poured out on us. That happened because we have sinned against God.

pt.L: E todo o Israel transgrediu a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} Lei e se desviou, não ouvindo a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} voz; por isso se derramaram sobre nós a maldição e o juramento que estão escritos na Lei de Moisés, servo de Deus, porque pecamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.B: Todo o Israel desobedeceu à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} Lei e se afastou, recusando-se a {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} obedecer. Por isso a maldição e o juramento escritos na Lei de Moisés, servo de Deus, foram derramados sobre nós, porque pecamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: Todo o povo de Israel desobedeceu à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} Lei e se afastou. Eles se recusaram a {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} obedecer. Por isso as maldições escritas na Lei de Moisés, servo de Deus, foram derramadas sobre nós. Isso aconteceu porque pecamos contra Deus.

fr.L: Et tout Israël a transgressé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi et s’est détourné, sans écouter {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} voix ; et se sont déversés sur nous la malédiction et le serment qui sont écrits dans la Loi de Moïse, serviteur de Dieu, car nous avons péché contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Tout Israël a enfreint {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi et s’est détourné, refusant de {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}obéir. Alors la malédiction et le serment écrits dans la Loi de Moïse, serviteur de Dieu, se sont déversés sur nous, parce que nous avons péché contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Tout le peuple d’Israël a désobéi à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi et s’est détourné. Ils ont refusé de {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}obéir. Alors les malédictions écrites dans la Loi de Moïse, serviteur de Dieu, se sont déversées sur nous. C’est arrivé parce que nous avons péché contre Dieu.

es.L: Y todo Israel ha transgredido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ley y se ha apartado para no escuchar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voz; por eso se han derramado sobre nosotros la maldición y el juramento que están escritos en la ley de Moisés, siervo de Dios, porque hemos pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Todo Israel ha quebrantado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ley y se ha apartado; no ha querido escuchar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voz. Por eso se han derramado sobre nosotros la maldición y el juramento que están escritos en la ley de Moisés, el siervo de Dios, porque hemos pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Todo el pueblo de Israel ha desobedecido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ley y se ha apartado. Se han negado a obedecer lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dices. Por eso han caído sobre nosotros las maldiciones que están escritas en la ley de Moisés, el siervo de Dios. Eso pasó porque hemos pecado contra Dios.

sw.L: Naye Israeli wote wameivunja sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, wakageuka, wasiisikilize sauti {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; kwa hiyo laana na kiapo vilivyoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa mtumishi wa Mungu vimemiminwa juu yetu, kwa sababu tumemtenda dhambi.
sw.B: Israeli wote wameivunja sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kugeuka mbali, wakakataa kukutii. Kwa hiyo laana na kiapo vilivyoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa, mtumishi wa Mungu, vimemiminwa juu yetu, kwa sababu tumemtenda dhambi.
sw.R: Watu wote wa Israeli wameivunja sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kugeuka mbali. Wamekataa kukutii. Kwa hiyo laana zilizoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa, mtumishi wa Mungu, zimemiminwa juu yetu. Hilo limetokea kwa sababu tumemtenda Mungu dhambi.

vi.L: Và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đã vi phạm luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và xây bỏ, không nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; nên sự nguyền rủa và lời thề đã được chép trong luật pháp của Môi-se, đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời, đã đổ xuống trên chúng con, vì chúng con đã phạm tội cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đã vi phạm luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và quay lưng đi, không chịu vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì thế, sự nguyền rủa và lời thề đã được chép trong luật pháp của Môi-se, đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời, đã đổ xuống trên chúng con, vì chúng con đã phạm tội cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã vi phạm luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và quay lưng đi. Họ không chịu vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì vậy những lời nguyền rủa đã chép trong luật pháp của Môi-se, đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời, đã đổ xuống trên chúng con. Điều ấy xảy ra vì chúng con đã phạm tội với Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 온 이스라엘이 주님의 율법을 어기고 떠나서 주님의 목소리를 듣지 않았습니다. 그래서 하나님의 종 모세의 율법에 기록된 저주와 맹세가 저희 위에 쏟아졌습니다. 저희가 그분께 죄를 지었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 온 이스라엘이 주님의 율법을 어기고 떠나서 주님께 순종하기를 거부했습니다. 그래서 하나님의 종 모세의 율법에 기록된 저주와 맹세가 저희에게 쏟아졌습니다. 저희가 그분께 죄를 지었기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 온 이스라엘 백성이 주님의 율법을 어기고 떠났습니다. 그들은 주님께 순종하기를 거부했습니다. 그래서 하나님의 종 모세의 율법에 기록된 저주들이 저희에게 쏟아졌습니다. 저희가 하나님께 죄를 지었기 때문에 그렇게 된 것입니다.

am.L: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ሕግህን ተላለፉ፤ ድምፅህንም እንዳይሰሙ ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ ስለዚህ በእርሱ ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተናልና በእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ በሙሴ ሕግ የተጻፈው ርግማንና መሐላ በላያችን ፈሰሰ።
am.B: እስራኤል ሁሉ ሕግህን ጥሰዋል፤ አንተንም ላለመታዘዝ ዘወር ብለዋል። ስለዚህ በእርሱ ላይ ኃጢአት ስለ ሠራን በእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ በሙሴ ሕግ የተጻፈው ርግማንና መሐላ በላያችን ፈሰሰ።
am.R: የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሕግህን ጥሰዋል፤ ዘወርም ብለዋል። አንተን አልታዘዝም አሉ። ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ በሆነው በሙሴ ሕግ የተጻፉት ርግማኖች በላያችን ፈሰሱ። ይህ የሆነው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ስለ ሠራን ነው።

hi.L: और सारे इस्राएल ने तेरी व्यवस्था का उल्लंघन किया है और हट गए हैं, कि तेरी बात न सुनें; इसलिए वह शाप और वह शपथ जो परमेश्वर के दास मूसा की व्यवस्था में लिखी है, हम पर उँडेली गई है, क्योंकि हमने उनके विरुद्ध पाप किया है।
hi.B: सारे इस्राएल ने तेरी व्यवस्था तोड़ी है और मुँह मोड़ लिया है, और तेरी बात मानने से इनकार किया है। इसलिए वह शाप और वह शपथ, जो परमेश्वर के दास मूसा की व्यवस्था में लिखी है, हम पर उँडेल दी गई है, क्योंकि हमने उनके विरुद्ध पाप किया है।
hi.R: इस्राएल के सब लोगों ने तेरी व्यवस्था तोड़ी है और मुँह मोड़ लिया है। उन्होंने तेरी बात मानने से इनकार किया है। इसलिए परमेश्वर के दास मूसा की व्यवस्था में लिखे हुए शाप हम पर उँडेल दिए गए हैं। यह इसलिए हुआ क्योंकि हमने परमेश्वर के विरुद्ध पाप किया है।

ru.L: И весь Израиль преступил {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Закон и отступил, чтобы не слушать {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} голоса; и излились на нас проклятие и клятва, написанные в Законе Моисея, раба Божьего, потому что мы согрешили против {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.
ru.B: Весь Израиль нарушил {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Закон и отвернулся, не желая слушаться {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Поэтому на нас излились проклятие и клятва, написанные в Законе Моисея, раба Божьего, потому что мы согрешили против {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.
ru.R: Весь народ Израиля нарушил {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Закон и отвернулся. Они не захотели слушаться {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Поэтому на нас обрушились проклятия, записанные в Законе Моисея, Божьего раба. Это случилось потому, что мы согрешили против Бога.

ja.L: イスラエルはみな、あなたの律法に背き、離れ去って、あなたの声に聞き従いませんでした。そこで、神のしもべモーセの律法に書かれている呪いと誓いが、わたしたちの上に注がれました。わたしたちがその方に罪を犯したからです。
ja.B: イスラエルはみな、あなたの律法を破り、離れ去って、あなたに聞き従おうとしませんでした。そこで、神のしもべモーセの律法に書かれている呪いと誓いが、わたしたちの上に注がれたのです。わたしたちが神に罪を犯したからです。
ja.R: イスラエルの人々はみな、あなたの律法を破り、離れて行きました。あなたに従おうとしませんでした。それで、神のしもべモーセの律法に書かれているのろいが、わたしたちの上に注がれたのです。わたしたちが、神に対して罪を犯したからです。

decisions.choice: the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses: Leviticus 26 and Deuteronomy 28-29
decisions.reason: The law of Moses ends its covenant with blessings for obedience and curses for disobedience, sealed with an oath (Leviticus 26:14-39; Deuteronomy 28:15-68; 29:11, 19-20). Exile and the ruin of the land are among the curses (Deuteronomy 28:36, 64; 29:27). Daniel sees them fulfilled.

decisions.choice: your law: God's torah, here the law given through Moses
decisions.reason: Here the word means the written law as a whole, as "the law of Moses" later in the verse shows.

decisions.choice: law (all levels); the law of Moses the servant of God (all levels)
decisions.reason: Torah is "instruction" in the prophets' table, but "the law of Moses" is the wording published for this phrase (Ezra 3:2; Malachi 3:22), and "your law" here means the same written law, so every level says "law". "Servant" is kept at every level, as in Malachi 3:22.

decisions.choice: the curses (R); God (R)
decisions.reason: Readable joins "the curse and the oath" as "the curses" and names God where the Hebrew says "him".

decisions.choice: a tua Lei; a Lei de Moisés (capital L)
decisions.reason: "Your law" here is the written Law of Moses (m2), which Portuguese capitalizes, as Nehemiah's Portuguese writes "a Lei de Moisés"; the two phrases in the verse are the same law, so both take the capital.

decisions.choice: "ta loi" at every level; "la Loi de Moïse" with a capital
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for Daniel 9:11, 13: here God's torah is the law given through Moses, so "loi" holds at every level, and "la Loi de Moïse" takes the capital it has in the New Testament.

decisions.choice: "율법" at every level for the law given through Moses
decisions.reason: Here torah is the law of Moses, which Korean calls "율법"; the same word holds in verse 13.

decisions.choice: "ley" at every level
decisions.reason: Here torah is the law given through Moses, so all levels say "ley", as the English does; "siervo" for Moses at every level

decisions.choice: "तेरी व्यवस्था"; "परमेश्वर के दास मूसा की व्यवस्था" (every level)
decisions.reason: Torah here is the law given through Moses (m2), so every level says "व्यवस्था", as Ezra 3:2 has "the law of Moses". The curse and the oath are those of Leviticus 26 and Deuteronomy 28-29 (m1); Readable joins them as "शाप" and names God where the Hebrew says "him", as the English does.

decisions.choice: Закон; Закон Моисея, раба Божьего
decisions.reason: God's law given through Moses is "Закон" with a capital, as in Ezra and Nehemiah in this translation, at every level.

decisions.choice: ha'alah vehashshevu'ah "呪いと誓い" (L, B), "のろい" (R); torat Mosheh "モーセの律法"
decisions.reason: The curses of Leviticus 26 and Deuteronomy 28-29 (m1); curse in kana at Readable, as the OT notes.

source.text: וַיָּ֜קֶם אֶת־דְּבָר֣וֹ׀אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלֵ֗ינוּ וְעַ֤ל שֹֽׁפְטֵ֨ינוּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁפָט֔וּנוּ לְהָבִ֥יא עָלֵ֖ינוּ רָעָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־נֶעֶשְׂתָ֗ה תַּ֚חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he has carried out his words which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us calamity great, which not has been done under all the heavens as has been done in Jerusalem.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has fulfilled {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, bringing on us great calamity; for under the whole heaven nothing has been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.
en.B: He has carried out the warnings {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke against us and against our rulers who governed us, by bringing on us a great disaster. Nowhere under heaven has anything been done like what was done to Jerusalem.
en.R: You did what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} would do to us and to our rulers. You brought a terrible disaster on us. Nothing anywhere in the world has ever been as bad as what happened to Jerusalem.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} cumpriu a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou contra nós e contra os nossos juízes que nos julgavam, trazendo sobre nós um grande mal; pois debaixo de todo o céu nada foi feito como o que foi feito a Jerusalém.
pt.B: Ele cumpriu as advertências que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez contra nós e contra os nossos governantes, trazendo sobre nós uma grande desgraça. Em nenhum lugar debaixo do céu se fez algo como o que foi feito a Jerusalém.
pt.R: Tu fizeste o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tinhas dito que farias contra nós e contra os nossos governantes. Trouxeste sobre nós uma desgraça terrível. Nada em nenhum lugar do mundo foi tão ruim quanto o que aconteceu a Jerusalém.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a accompli {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait prononcées contre nous et contre nos juges qui nous ont jugés, en faisant venir sur nous un grand malheur ; car sous tous les cieux il n’a rien été fait de semblable à ce qui a été fait à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Il a exécuté les menaces qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait prononcées contre nous et contre ceux qui nous gouvernaient, en faisant venir sur nous un grand malheur. Nulle part sous le ciel on n’a rien fait de pareil à ce qui a été fait à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Tu as fait ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais dit que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous ferais, à nous et à nos chefs. Tu as fait venir sur nous un terrible malheur. Nulle part dans le monde il n’est jamais rien arrivé d’aussi terrible qu’à Jérusalem.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha cumplido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra que habló contra nosotros y contra nuestros jueces que nos juzgaron, trayendo sobre nosotros una gran calamidad; porque debajo de todo el cielo no se ha hecho nada como lo que se ha hecho en Jerusalén.
es.B: Él ha cumplido las advertencias que hizo contra nosotros y contra nuestros gobernantes, trayendo sobre nosotros una gran desgracia. En ningún lugar bajo el cielo se ha hecho algo como lo que se hizo en Jerusalén.
es.R: Hiciste lo que habías dicho que nos harías a nosotros y a nuestros gobernantes. Trajiste sobre nosotros una desgracia terrible. Nunca ha pasado en ningún lugar del mundo nada tan malo como lo que pasó en Jerusalén.

sw.L: Naye amelithibitisha neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} alilolisema juu yetu na juu ya waamuzi wetu waliotuhukumu, kwa kuleta juu yetu maafa makubwa; kwa maana chini ya mbingu zote halijafanyika jambo kama lililofanyika Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Ameyatimiza maonyo aliyoyasema dhidi yetu na dhidi ya watawala wetu waliotuongoza, kwa kutuletea maafa makubwa. Hakuna mahali popote chini ya mbingu palipofanyika jambo kama lililofanyika Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Ulifanya yale uliyosema utatufanyia sisi na watawala wetu. Ulituletea maafa makubwa sana. Hakuna kitu chochote duniani kilichowahi kuwa kibaya kama kilichotokea Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm trọn lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán nghịch cùng chúng con và nghịch cùng các quan xét đã xét xử chúng con, bằng cách giáng trên chúng con tai họa lớn; vì dưới cả bầu trời chưa từng có điều gì được làm như điều đã được làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Ngài đã thực hiện những lời cảnh cáo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán nghịch cùng chúng con và các nhà cai trị đã cai quản chúng con, khi giáng trên chúng con một tai họa lớn. Khắp dưới trời, chưa từng có nơi nào phải chịu điều như Giê-ru-sa-lem đã chịu.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán sẽ làm cho chúng con và cho các nhà cai trị của chúng con. Ngài đã giáng trên chúng con một tai họa khủng khiếp. Không nơi nào trên thế giới từng phải chịu điều tồi tệ như điều đã xảy ra cho Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서는 저희와 저희를 다스리던 저희 재판관들에게 하신 그분의 말씀을 이루시어, 저희에게 큰 재앙을 내리셨습니다. 온 하늘 아래에서 예루살렘에 행해진 것과 같은 일이 행해진 적이 없었습니다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 저희와 저희를 다스리던 통치자들에게 경고하신 말씀을 그대로 이루시어, 저희에게 큰 재앙을 내리셨습니다. 하늘 아래 어디에서도 예루살렘에 일어난 것과 같은 일이 일어난 적이 없습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 저희와 저희 통치자들에게 하시겠다고 말씀하신 일을 그대로 하셨습니다. 주님께서 저희에게 끔찍한 재앙을 내리셨습니다. 세상 어디에서도 예루살렘에 일어난 일만큼 끔찍한 일은 없었습니다.

am.L: በእኛና በፈረዱልን ፈራጆቻችን ላይ የተናገረውን ቃሉን አጸና፤ ታላቅ ክፉ ነገርን አመጣብን፤ በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ተደረገው ያለ ከሰማይ ሁሉ በታች አልተደረገምና።
am.B: በእኛና በገዙን ገዢዎቻችን ላይ የተናገረውን ማስጠንቀቂያ ፈጸመ፤ ታላቅ ጥፋትንም አመጣብን። በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ተደረገው ያለ ከሰማይ በታች የትም አልተደረገም።
am.R: በእኛና በገዢዎቻችን ላይ አደርጋለሁ ያልከውን አደረግህ። አስከፊ ጥፋትን አመጣህብን። በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ደረሰው ያለ ክፉ ነገር በዓለም ላይ የትም ደርሶ አያውቅም።

hi.L: और उन्होंने अपने वचन पूरे किए हैं जो उन्होंने हमारे विरुद्ध और हमारे न्याय करनेवाले न्यायियों के विरुद्ध कहे थे, कि हम पर बड़ी विपत्ति लाएँ; क्योंकि सारे आकाश के नीचे ऐसा कुछ नहीं किया गया जैसा यरूशलेम के साथ किया गया है।
hi.B: उन्होंने वे चेतावनियाँ पूरी कीं जो उन्होंने हमारे और हम पर शासन करनेवाले हमारे शासकों के विरुद्ध दी थीं, और हम पर बड़ी विपत्ति ले आए। आकाश के नीचे कहीं भी ऐसा कुछ नहीं किया गया जैसा यरूशलेम के साथ किया गया।
hi.R: तूने वही किया जो तूने हमारे और हमारे शासकों के साथ करने को कहा था। तू हम पर भयानक विपत्ति ले आया। संसार में कहीं भी कभी इतना बुरा नहीं हुआ जितना यरूशलेम के साथ हुआ है।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} исполнил свои слова, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал против нас и против наших судей, которые судили нас, наведя на нас великое бедствие, какого не было сделано под всем небом, как сделано в Иерусалиме.
ru.B: Он исполнил предостережения, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} высказал против нас и против наших правителей, которые управляли нами, наведя на нас великую беду. Нигде под небом не было сделано ничего подобного тому, что было сделано с Иерусалимом.
ru.R: Ты исполнил то, чем {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} грозил нам и нашим правителям. Ты навёл на нас страшную беду. Нигде в мире никогда не было ничего такого ужасного, как то, что случилось с Иерусалимом.

ja.L: その方は、わたしたちと、わたしたちを裁いた裁き手たちに対して語られた言葉を成就し、わたしたちの上に大きな災いをもたらされました。エルサレムに行われたようなことは、全天の下で行われたことがありません。
ja.B: その方は、わたしたちと、わたしたちを治めた指導者たちに対して語られた警告を実行し、大きな災いをわたしたちにもたらされました。エルサレムに起こったようなことは、天の下のどこにも起こったことがありません。
ja.R: あなたは、わたしたちと、わたしたちの指導者たちに、こうすると言われたとおりのことをなさいました。わたしたちに恐ろしい災いをもたらされたのです。エルサレムに起こったことほどひどいことは、世界のどこでも起こったことがありません。

decisions.choice: our judges who judged us: our rulers
decisions.reason: "Judges" here means all who governed Israel, kings and officials, as in Psalm 2:10 and Amos 2:3.

decisions.choice: nothing like what has been done to Jerusalem: the language of Lamentations
decisions.reason: Lamentations asks whether there is any sorrow like Jerusalem's (Lamentations 1:12; 2:13). The calamity of 587 BC was the curse of the covenant in full.

decisions.choice: the warnings (B); what you said you would do (R)
decisions.reason: The words God spoke against them are the warnings of the law and the prophets; Balanced and Readable say so. Readable turns the third person to "you", as in verse 9.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" throughout (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable turns to "you" here; Vietnamese "Ngài" already serves for God both spoken to and spoken of, so the change of person needs no other word.

decisions.choice: "저희를 다스리던 저희 재판관들" (L); "통치자들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The judges here are the people's rulers, as the meaning decision says; Literal keeps the word, the other levels give its sense.

decisions.choice: "वचन" (Literal); "चेतावनियाँ" (Balanced); "जो तूने ... करने को कहा था" (Readable); "न्यायी" (Literal), "शासक" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The words God spoke against them are the warnings of the law and the prophets, and "our judges who judged us" are the rulers (m1); Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does. Readable turns to "you", as in verse 9.

decisions.choice: shofteinu asher shefatunu "わたしたちを裁いた裁き手たち" (L), "わたしたちを治めた指導者たち" (B), "わたしたちの指導者たち" (R)
decisions.reason: Our judges are our rulers (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew repetition.

source.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בָּ֣אָה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וְלֹֽא־חִלִּ֜ינוּ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ לָשׁוּב֙ מֵֽעֲוֺנֵ֔נוּ וּלְהַשְׂכִּ֖יל בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: As [is] written in [the] law of Moses, all the calamity this has come on us; and not we have entreated the face of Yahweh our God by turning from our iniquity and by giving attention to your truth.

en.L: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this calamity has come upon us; yet we have not entreated the face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God by turning back from our iniquities and paying attention to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth.
en.B: All this disaster has come on us, as the law of Moses says it would. Yet we have not pleaded for the favor of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God by turning away from our sins and paying attention to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth.
en.R: Everything happened to us just as it was written in the law of Moses. All this disaster came on us. But we still have not asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God to be kind to us. We have not turned away from our sins or paid attention to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth.

pt.L: Como está escrito na Lei de Moisés, todo este mal veio sobre nós; e não suplicamos diante da face {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, nosso Deus, convertendo-nos das nossas iniquidades e atentando para a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade.
pt.B: Toda esta desgraça veio sobre nós, como a Lei de Moisés tinha dito. Mesmo assim, não buscamos o favor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, nosso Deus, abandonando os nossos pecados e prestando atenção à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade.
pt.R: Tudo aconteceu conosco exatamente como estava escrito na Lei de Moisés. Toda esta desgraça veio sobre nós. Mas ainda não pedimos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, nosso Deus, que tivesse compaixão de nós. Não abandonamos os nossos pecados nem prestamos atenção à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade.

fr.L: Comme il est écrit dans la Loi de Moïse, tout ce malheur est venu sur nous ; et nous n’avons pas imploré la face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu en revenant de nos iniquités et en étant attentifs à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité.
fr.B: Tout ce malheur est venu sur nous, comme la Loi de Moïse l’avait dit. Pourtant, nous n’avons pas cherché la faveur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu en nous détournant de nos péchés et en prêtant attention à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité.
fr.R: Tout est arrivé comme c’était écrit dans la Loi de Moïse. Tout ce malheur est venu sur nous. Mais nous n’avons toujours pas demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} notre Dieu d’être bon pour nous. Nous ne nous sommes pas détournés de nos péchés et nous n’avons pas fait attention à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité.

es.L: Como está escrito en la ley de Moisés, toda esta calamidad ha venido sobre nosotros; y no hemos suplicado ante el rostro {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, volviéndonos de nuestras iniquidades y prestando atención a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad.
es.B: Toda esta desgracia ha caído sobre nosotros, tal como lo dice la ley de Moisés. Sin embargo, no hemos buscado el favor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios apartándonos de nuestros pecados y prestando atención a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad.
es.R: Todo nos pasó tal como estaba escrito en la ley de Moisés. Toda esta desgracia cayó sobre nosotros. Pero todavía no hemos pedido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios que tenga compasión de nosotros. No nos hemos apartado de nuestros pecados ni hemos prestado atención a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad.

sw.L: Kama ilivyoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa, maafa haya yote yametujia; wala hatukuusihi uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu kwa kurudi kutoka katika maovu yetu na kuizingatia kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Maafa haya yote yametujia, kama sheria ya Musa ilivyosema. Lakini hatukumsihi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu atufadhili kwa kuziacha dhambi zetu na kuizingatia kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Kila kitu kilitupata kama kilivyoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa. Maafa haya yote yametujia. Lakini bado hatujamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu atuhurumie. Hatujaziacha dhambi zetu wala kuizingatia kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

vi.L: Như đã chép trong luật pháp của Môi-se, tất cả tai họa này đã đến trên chúng con; thế mà chúng con đã không nài xin ơn trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, bằng cách quay khỏi các điều gian ác của chúng con và chú tâm vào chân lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Mọi tai họa này đã đến trên chúng con, đúng như luật pháp Môi-se đã chép. Thế mà chúng con vẫn không cầu xin ơn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng con bằng cách lìa bỏ tội lỗi mình và chú tâm vào chân lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Mọi việc đã xảy đến cho chúng con đúng như đã chép trong luật pháp Môi-se. Tất cả tai họa này đã đến trên chúng con. Thế mà chúng con vẫn chưa cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con tỏ lòng nhân từ với chúng con. Chúng con đã không lìa bỏ tội lỗi mình, cũng không để tâm đến chân lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 모세의 율법에 기록된 대로 이 모든 재앙이 저희에게 닥쳤습니다. 그런데도 저희는 저희 죄악에서 돌아서고 주님의 진리를 깨달음으로써 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 얼굴을 달래지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 모세의 율법에 기록된 대로 이 모든 재앙이 저희에게 닥쳤습니다. 그런데도 저희는 죄에서 돌아서고 주님의 진리에 마음을 기울여 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 은총을 구하지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 모세의 율법에 기록된 그대로 모든 일이 저희에게 일어났습니다. 이 모든 재앙이 저희에게 닥쳤습니다. 그런데도 저희는 아직도 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 은혜를 베풀어 달라고 구하지 않았습니다. 저희는 죄에서 돌아서지도 않았고, 주님의 진리에 귀를 기울이지도 않았습니다.

am.L: በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ ይህ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በላያችን መጣ፤ ነገር ግን ከበደላችን በመመለስና እውነትህን በማስተዋል የአምላካችንን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ፊት አልለመንም።
am.B: የሙሴ ሕግ እንደሚለው ይህ ጥፋት ሁሉ በላያችን መጣ። ቢሆንም ከኃጢአታችን በመመለስና እውነትህን በማስተዋል የአምላካችንን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ሞገስ አልለመንም።
am.R: ልክ በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈው ሁሉም ነገር ደረሰብን። ይህ ጥፋት ሁሉ በላያችን መጣ። እኛ ግን አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲራራልን እስካሁን አልለመንም። ከኃጢአታችን አልተመለስንም፤ እውነትህንም አላስተዋልንም።

hi.L: जैसा मूसा की व्यवस्था में लिखा है, यह सारी विपत्ति हम पर आ पड़ी है; तो भी हमने अपने अधर्म के कामों से फिरकर और तेरी सच्चाई पर ध्यान देकर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से विनती नहीं की।
hi.B: जैसा मूसा की व्यवस्था में लिखा है, वैसे ही यह सारी विपत्ति हम पर आ पड़ी है। फिर भी हमने अपने पापों से फिरकर और तेरी सच्चाई पर ध्यान देकर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की कृपा के लिए विनती नहीं की।
hi.R: जैसा मूसा की व्यवस्था में लिखा था, ठीक वैसा ही हमारे साथ हुआ। यह सारी विपत्ति हम पर आ पड़ी। फिर भी हमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से नहीं कहा कि हम पर कृपा करें। हम अपने पापों से नहीं फिरे और तेरी सच्चाई पर ध्यान नहीं दिया।

ru.L: Как написано в Законе Моисея, всё это бедствие пришло на нас; а мы не умоляли лица {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, чтобы обратиться от наших беззаконий и вникнуть в {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} истину.
ru.B: Всё это бедствие пришло на нас, как и сказано в Законе Моисея. И всё же мы не просили милости у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, не отвернулись от наших грехов и не вникли в {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} истину.
ru.R: Всё случилось с нами так, как было написано в Законе Моисея. Вся эта беда пришла на нас. Но мы всё равно не попросили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, быть милостивым к нам. Мы не отвернулись от своих грехов и не обратили внимания на {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} истину.

ja.L: モーセの律法に書かれているとおり、このすべての災いがわたしたちに臨みました。それでも、わたしたちは咎から立ち返り、あなたの真理に心を留めることによって、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の顔を和らげようとはしませんでした。
ja.B: モーセの律法に書かれているとおり、このすべての災いがわたしたちに臨みました。それでも、わたしたちは罪から立ち返り、あなたの真理に心を留めて、わたしたちの神である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の恵みを願い求めることをしませんでした。
ja.R: モーセの律法に書かれていたとおりのことが、すべてわたしたちに起こりました。この災いがみな、わたしたちの上に臨んだのです。それでも、わたしたちはまだ、わたしたちの神である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に、あわれんでくださいとお願いしていません。罪から離れることも、あなたの真理に心を留めることもしてきませんでした。

decisions.choice: entreat the face of the LORD: seek his favor
decisions.reason: The phrase means literally "soften the face" of someone, that is, seek to win his favor by pleading (Exodus 32:11; Jeremiah 26:19).

decisions.choice: your truth: your faithfulness, the truth of your word
decisions.reason: The word means truth and faithfulness. They have not given heed to God's true word and his faithfulness to it. Some take it as "insight into your truth".

decisions.choice: iniquities (L); sins (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word for iniquity follows the Isaiah table: "iniquity" at Literal, "sin" at Balanced and Readable. The Hebrew is singular, used for the whole; Literal makes it plural to match "our".

decisions.choice: "얼굴을 달래다" (L); "은총을 구하다" (B); "은혜를 베풀어 달라고 구하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of softening someone's face; Balanced and Readable say that it means seeking God's favour.

decisions.choice: "अधर्म के कामों" (Literal); "पापों" (Balanced, Readable); "विनती की" for "entreated the face"
decisions.reason: Iniquity is "अधर्म" at Literal, and "पाप" at Balanced and Readable, as the English says "sins"; "entreat the face of the LORD" is to seek his favour (m1).

decisions.choice: chillinu et-penei "顔を和らげようとはしませんでした" (L), "恵みを願い求めることをしませんでした" (B), "あわれんでくださいとお願いしていません" (R)
decisions.reason: To entreat the face of the LORD is to seek his favor (m1); Literal keeps the face.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁקֹ֤ד יְהוָה֙ עַל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה וַיְבִיאֶ֖הָ עָלֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־צַדִּ֞יק יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַל־כָּל־מַֽעֲשָׂיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh kept watch over the calamity and brought it on us, for righteous [is] Yahweh our God in all his deeds which he has done, and not we have listened to his voice.

en.L: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} kept watch over the calamity and brought it on us, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is righteous in all the works {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done, but we have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice.
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} kept the disaster ready and brought it on us, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is righteous in everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does, yet we have not obeyed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was ready to bring this disaster on us, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought it. {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is always right in everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does. But we did not obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

pt.L: Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vigiou sobre o mal e o trouxe sobre nós, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus, é justo em todas as obras que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez; mas nós não ouvimos a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} voz.
pt.B: Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} manteve a desgraça preparada e a trouxe sobre nós, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus, é justo em tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz; mas nós não {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} obedecemos.
pt.R: Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} estava pronto para trazer esta desgraça sobre nós, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a trouxe. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus, é sempre justo em tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz. Mas nós não {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} obedecemos.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a veillé sur le malheur et l’a fait venir sur nous, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu est juste dans toutes les œuvres qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites, et nous n’avons pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix.
fr.B: Ainsi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a tenu ce malheur prêt et l’a fait venir sur nous, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu est juste dans tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait, et nous ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avons pas obéi.
fr.R: Ainsi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} tenait prêt à faire venir ce malheur sur nous, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait venir. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu fait toujours ce qui est juste dans tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait. Mais nous ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avons pas obéi.

es.L: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} veló sobre la calamidad y la trajo sobre nosotros, porque justo [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios en todas las obras que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho, pero nosotros no hemos escuchado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tuvo preparada la desgracia y la trajo sobre nosotros, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios es justo en todo lo que hace; y nosotros no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hemos obedecido.
es.R: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba listo para traer esta desgracia sobre nosotros, y la trajo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios siempre actúa con justicia en todo lo que hace. Pero nosotros no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} obedecimos.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akayakesha maafa hayo, akayaleta juu yetu; kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu ni mwenye haki katika kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote alizozifanya, wala sisi hatukuisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyaweka tayari maafa hayo, akayaleta juu yetu, kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu ni mwenye haki katika yote anayoyafanya; lakini sisi hatukumtii.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa tayari kutuletea maafa haya, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akayaleta. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu hutenda yaliyo haki siku zote katika kila jambo analofanya. Lakini sisi hatukumtii.

vi.L: Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã canh thức trên tai họa và giáng nó trên chúng con, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con là công chính trong mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm, nhưng chúng con đã không nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giữ sẵn tai họa này và giáng nó trên chúng con, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con là công chính trong mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm, còn chúng con thì không vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sẵn sàng giáng tai họa này trên chúng con, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giáng xuống. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con luôn làm điều đúng trong mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm. Nhưng chúng con đã không vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 재앙을 지켜보고 계시다가 저희에게 내리셨습니다. 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분께서 행하신 모든 일에 의로우시나, 저희는 그분의 목소리를 듣지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 재앙을 준비해 두셨다가 저희에게 내리셨습니다. 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하시는 모든 일에 의로우신데, 저희는 그분께 순종하지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이 재앙을 내리시려고 준비하고 계시다가 내리셨습니다. 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하시는 모든 일에 언제나 옳으십니다. 그러나 저희는 그분께 순종하지 않았습니다.

am.L: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ክፉውን ነገር ተጠባበቀ፤ በላያችንም አመጣው፤ አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነውና፤ እኛ ግን ድምፁን አልሰማንም።
am.B: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጥፋቱን አዘጋጅቶ ጠበቀ፤ በላያችንም አመጣው፤ አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሚያደርገው ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነውና፤ እኛ ግን አልታዘዝነውም።
am.R: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህን ጥፋት ሊያመጣብን ተዘጋጅቶ ነበር፤ አመጣውም። አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሚያደርገው ሁሉ ሁልጊዜ ትክክል ነው። እኛ ግን አልታዘዝነውም።

hi.L: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उस विपत्ति पर दृष्टि रखी और उसे हम पर ले आए; क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर अपने सब कामों में जो वे करते हैं, धर्मी हैं; पर हमने उनकी बात नहीं सुनी।
hi.B: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने वह विपत्ति तैयार रखी और उसे हम पर ले आए, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर अपने हर काम में धर्मी हैं; फिर भी हमने उनकी आज्ञा नहीं मानी।
hi.R: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह विपत्ति हम पर लाने को तैयार थे, और वे उसे ले आए। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर जो कुछ करते हैं, उसमें हमेशा सही होते हैं। पर हमने उनकी आज्ञा नहीं मानी।

ru.L: И {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} бодрствовал над бедствием и навёл его на нас, потому что праведен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог, во всех делах, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} совершил, а мы не слушали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} голоса.
ru.B: Поэтому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} держал эту беду наготове и навёл её на нас, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог, праведен во всём, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} делает, а мы не послушались {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.R: Поэтому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} был готов навести на нас эту беду, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} навёл её. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог, всегда прав во всём, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} делает. А мы не послушались {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.

ja.L: そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はその災いを見張っておられ、それをわたしたちにもたらされました。わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、行われたすべてのわざにおいて正しい方だからです。しかし、わたしたちはその方の声に聞き従いませんでした。
ja.B: そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、その災いを備えておられ、それをわたしたちにもたらされました。わたしたちの神である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、なさることすべてにおいて正しい方です。それなのに、わたしたちはその方に聞き従いませんでした。
ja.R: それで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、この災いをもたらそうと備えておられ、それをもたらされました。わたしたちの神である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、なさることのすべてにおいて、いつも正しい方です。しかし、わたしたちは、その方に従いませんでした。

decisions.choice: the LORD kept watch over the calamity: the word of Jeremiah 1:12
decisions.reason: The verb is the one in the LORD's wordplay with Jeremiah: "I am watching over my word to perform it" (Jeremiah 1:12), and "I am watching over them for harm" (Jeremiah 44:27). God was ready to bring the disaster he had threatened, and he did.

decisions.choice: the LORD our God is righteous: the judgment was just
decisions.reason: As in verse 7, the prayer confesses that God was in the right in what he did.

decisions.choice: kept the disaster ready (B); was ready to bring (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "kept watch over"; Balanced and Readable give the sense of the verb here (m1). Balanced and Readable say "obeyed" for "listened to his voice".

decisions.choice: "akayakesha maafa hayo" (L)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of Jeremiah 1:12, which the published Swahili renders "ninakesha"; Literal keeps that echo, as the meaning decision points to Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "canh thức trên" (L)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision hears Jeremiah 1:12, whose published Literal is "Ta đang canh thức trên lời Ta"; Literal keeps the verb so the echo can be seen.

decisions.choice: "지켜보고 계시다가" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb of Jeremiah 1:12 as published ("지켜보고 있다가"), so the allusion is visible; Balanced and Readable give the sense, keeping the disaster ready.

decisions.choice: "veló sobre" (L)
decisions.reason: The verb of Jeremiah 1:12, where the Spanish has God watching over his word ("vigilando"); L keeps the image

decisions.choice: "a veillé sur le malheur" (L), the verb of Jeremiah 1:12
decisions.reason: The meaning decision points to Jeremiah 1:12, where God watches over his word to carry it out; Literal keeps the verb "veiller" so the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: "दृष्टि रखी" (Literal); "तैयार रखी" (Balanced); "लाने को तैयार थे" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "kept watch over", the verb of Jeremiah 1:12 (m1); Balanced and Readable give its sense here, as the English does.

decisions.choice: yishqod "見張っておられ" (L), "備えておられ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word of Jeremiah 1:12 (m1): Literal keeps "watch over", the other levels say the disaster was kept ready, as the English.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ הוֹצֵ֨אתָ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֜ מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה וַתַּֽעַשׂ־לְךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה חָטָ֖אנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Lord our God, who brought out your people from [the] land of Egypt with a hand strong, and made for yourself a name as this day: we have sinned, we have acted wickedly.

en.L: And now, Lord our God, who brought {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people out from the land of Egypt with a strong hand and made a name for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}, as at this day, we have sinned, we have acted wickedly.
en.B: Now, Lord our God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rescued {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people from the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and made a name for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} that lasts to this day. We have sinned; we have done wrong.
en.R: Lord our God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} used {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great power to bring {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people out of Egypt. Because of that, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are famous even today. But we have sinned. We have done wicked things.

pt.L: E agora, Senhor nosso Deus, que tiraste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo da terra do Egito com mão forte e fizeste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} um nome, como neste dia, pecamos, agimos impiamente.
pt.B: Agora, Senhor nosso Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} livraste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo da terra do Egito com mão poderosa e fizeste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} um nome que dura até hoje. Nós pecamos; fizemos o mal.
pt.R: Senhor nosso Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} usaste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} grande poder para tirar o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo do Egito. Por isso o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome é conhecido até hoje. Mas nós pecamos. Fizemos coisas más.

fr.L: Et maintenant, Seigneur notre Dieu, qui as fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple du pays d’Égypte d’une main forte et qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es fait un nom, comme en ce jour : nous avons péché, nous avons agi méchamment.
fr.B: Maintenant, Seigneur notre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple du pays d’Égypte d’une main puissante, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es fait un nom qui dure jusqu’à ce jour. Nous avons péché, nous avons fait le mal.
fr.R: Seigneur notre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as utilisé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande puissance pour faire sortir {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple d’Égypte. À cause de cela, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es célèbre encore aujourd’hui. Mais nous avons péché. Nous avons fait le mal.

es.L: Y ahora, Señor nuestro Dios, que sacaste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo de la tierra de Egipto con mano fuerte, y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hiciste un nombre, como en este día: hemos pecado, hemos actuado impíamente.
es.B: Ahora, Señor nuestro Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} rescataste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo de la tierra de Egipto con mano poderosa y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hiciste un nombre que perdura hasta hoy. Hemos pecado; hemos hecho lo malo.
es.R: Señor nuestro Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} usaste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran poder para sacar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo de Egipto. Por eso eres famoso aún hoy. Pero nosotros hemos pecado. Hemos hecho cosas malas.

sw.L: Na sasa, Bwana Mungu wetu, uliyewatoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kutoka nchi ya Misri kwa mkono wenye nguvu, ukajifanyia jina, kama ilivyo leo, tumetenda dhambi, tumetenda uovu.
sw.B: Sasa, Bwana Mungu wetu, uliwaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kutoka nchi ya Misri kwa mkono wenye nguvu, ukajipatia jina linalodumu hadi leo. Tumetenda dhambi; tumefanya maovu.
sw.R: Bwana Mungu wetu, ulitumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kuu kuwatoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Misri. Kwa sababu hiyo, unajulikana hata leo. Lakini sisi tumetenda dhambi. Tumefanya mambo maovu.

vi.L: Và bây giờ, lạy Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, Đấng đã đem dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập bằng tay mạnh mẽ và đã làm nên danh cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như ngày nay, chúng con đã phạm tội, chúng con đã làm điều gian ác.
vi.B: Giờ đây, lạy Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dùng tay quyền năng giải cứu dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập và làm cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được lừng lẫy đến ngày nay. Chúng con đã phạm tội; chúng con đã làm điều ác.
vi.R: Lạy Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dùng quyền năng lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để đem dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra khỏi Ai Cập. Nhờ vậy mà đến nay danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn còn lừng lẫy. Nhưng chúng con đã phạm tội. Chúng con đã làm những điều gian ác.

ko.L: 그리고 이제, 강한 손으로 주님의 백성을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내시고, 오늘과 같이 주님의 이름을 떨치신 주 저희 하나님, 저희가 죄를 지었고 악을 행했습니다.
ko.B: 주 저희 하나님, 주님께서는 강한 손으로 주님의 백성을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내시고, 오늘까지 이어지는 이름을 얻으셨습니다. 저희가 죄를 짓고 악한 일을 했습니다.
ko.R: 주 저희 하나님, 주님께서는 큰 능력으로 주님의 백성을 이집트에서 이끌어 내셨습니다. 그 일 때문에 주님의 이름은 오늘까지 널리 알려져 있습니다. 그러나 저희는 죄를 지었습니다. 저희는 악한 일을 했습니다.

am.L: አሁንም ሕዝብህን በብርቱ እጅ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣህ፣ እንደ ዛሬም ለራስህ ስም ያደረግህ አምላካችን ጌታ ሆይ፣ ኃጢአት ሠርተናል፤ ክፋትን አድርገናል።
am.B: አሁንም አምላካችን ጌታ ሆይ፣ ሕዝብህን በብርቱ እጅ ከግብፅ ምድር አዳንህ፤ እስከ ዛሬም የሚኖር ስም ለራስህ አደረግህ። እኛ ኃጢአት ሠርተናል፤ ክፉ አድርገናል።
am.R: አምላካችን ጌታ ሆይ፣ ሕዝብህን ከግብፅ ያወጣኸው በታላቅ ኃይልህ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ስምህ የታወቀ ነው። እኛ ግን ኃጢአት ሠርተናል። ክፉ ነገሮችን አድርገናል።

hi.L: और अब, हे प्रभु हमारे परमेश्वर, जिसने अपनी प्रजा को बलवन्त हाथ से मिस्र देश से निकाल लाकर अपना ऐसा नाम किया जैसा आज के दिन है, हमने पाप किया है, हमने दुष्टता की है।
hi.B: अब, हे प्रभु हमारे परमेश्वर, तूने अपनी प्रजा को बलवन्त हाथ से मिस्र देश से छुड़ाया और अपना ऐसा नाम किया जो आज तक बना है। हमने पाप किया है; हमने बुरा किया है।
hi.R: हे प्रभु हमारे परमेश्वर, तूने अपनी महान शक्ति से अपनी प्रजा को मिस्र से निकाला। इसी कारण आज भी तेरा नाम प्रसिद्ध है। पर हमने पाप किया है। हमने दुष्टता के काम किए हैं।

ru.L: И теперь, Господь мой, Боже наш, выведший {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ из земли Египетской рукой сильной и сделавший себе имя, как в этот день, — мы согрешили, мы поступили нечестиво.
ru.B: Теперь, Господи, Боже наш, — {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} вывел свой народ из земли Египетской могучей рукой и прославил своё имя до сего дня. Мы согрешили, мы поступали нечестиво.
ru.R: Господи, Боже наш, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} своей великой силой вывел свой народ из Египта. Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} прославлен и сегодня. Но мы согрешили. Мы поступали нечестиво.

ja.L: そして今、わたしたちの神である主よ、あなたは力強い手をもって、あなたの民をエジプトの地から導き出し、今日のように、ご自分のために名をあげられました。わたしたちは罪を犯し、悪を行いました。
ja.B: 今、わたしたちの神である主よ、あなたは力強い手をもって、あなたの民をエジプトの地から救い出し、今日に至るまでご自分の名を高められました。わたしたちは罪を犯し、悪を行いました。
ja.R: わたしたちの神である主よ、あなたは大きな力を使って、あなたの民をエジプトから連れ出してくださいました。そのために、あなたの名は今でも広く知られています。しかし、わたしたちは罪を犯しました。悪いことをしてきました。

decisions.choice: brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and made a name for yourself
decisions.reason: The prayer turns from confession to request by recalling the exodus (Exodus 32:11; Deuteronomy 7:8). By rescuing Israel from Egypt, God made his name known among the nations (Jeremiah 32:20-21; Nehemiah 9:10). Daniel appeals to that name in verses 17-19.

decisions.choice: with a mighty hand: by great power
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power (Exodus 13:9; Deuteronomy 26:8).

decisions.choice: your, yourself (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: Daniel's prayer speaks to God as "you" and about him as "he"; every such pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting, except at the start of a sentence. Readable says "with your great power" for "with a mighty hand" (m2).

decisions.choice: "큰 능력으로" (R) for "with a strong hand"
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the idiom, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "बलवन्त हाथ से" (Literal, Balanced); "अपनी महान शक्ति से" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "With a mighty hand" means by great power (m2); Literal and Balanced keep the picture, as the Pentateuch does for the exodus, and Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: beyad chazaqah "力強い手をもって" (L, B), "大きな力を使って" (R); "名をあげられました" (L), "名を高められました" (B), "名は今でも広く知られています" (R)
decisions.reason: The exodus formula (m1); the mighty hand is great power (m2).

source.text: אֲדֹנָ֗י כְּכָל־צִדְקֹתֶ֨ךָ֙ יָֽשָׁב־נָ֤א אַפְּךָ֙ וַחֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ מֵעִֽירְךָ֥ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הַר־קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ כִּ֤י בַחֲטָאֵ֨ינוּ֙ וּבַעֲוֺנ֣וֹת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֧ם וְעַמְּךָ֛ לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לְכָל־סְבִיבֹתֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Lord, according to all your righteousnesses, let turn back, please, your anger and your wrath from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; for by our sins and by the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people [are] a reproach to all around us.

en.L: Lord, according to all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteous acts, let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wrath turn away, please, from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} city Jerusalem, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy mountain. For by our sins and by the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people have been made a reproach among all our neighbors.
en.B: Lord, in keeping with all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteous acts, turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} city Jerusalem, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy mountain. Because of our sins and the wrongdoing of our ancestors, Jerusalem and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people have become an object of scorn to all the nations around us.
en.R: Lord, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have always done what is right. So please stop being angry with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} city Jerusalem, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy mountain. Because of our sins and the sins of our ancestors, all the people around us make fun of Jerusalem and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people.

pt.L: Senhor, segundo todos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} atos de justiça, desvie-se, por favor, a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} furor da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} cidade, Jerusalém, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santo monte. Porque, por causa dos nossos pecados e das iniquidades dos nossos pais, Jerusalém e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo se tornaram objeto de escárnio para todos os que estão ao nosso redor.
pt.B: Senhor, de acordo com todos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} atos de justiça, afasta a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} furor da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} cidade, Jerusalém, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santo monte. Por causa dos nossos pecados e das maldades dos nossos antepassados, Jerusalém e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo se tornaram motivo de zombaria para todas as nações ao nosso redor.
pt.R: Senhor, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sempre fizeste o que é justo. Por isso, por favor, deixa de estar irado com a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} cidade, Jerusalém, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santo monte. Por causa dos nossos pecados e dos pecados dos nossos antepassados, todos os povos ao nosso redor zombam de Jerusalém e do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo.

fr.L: Seigneur, selon toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} justices, que se détournent, de grâce, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ville, Jérusalem, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} montagne sainte ; car à cause de nos péchés et des iniquités de nos pères, Jérusalem et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple sont un objet d’opprobre pour tous ceux qui nous entourent.
fr.B: Seigneur, selon toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres de justice, détourne {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ville, Jérusalem, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} montagne sainte. À cause de nos péchés et des fautes de nos ancêtres, Jérusalem et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple sont devenus un objet de mépris pour toutes les nations qui nous entourent.
fr.R: Seigneur, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as toujours fait ce qui est juste. Alors, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, ne sois plus en colère contre {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ville, Jérusalem, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} montagne sainte. À cause de nos péchés et des péchés de nos ancêtres, tous les peuples autour de nous se moquent de Jérusalem et de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple.

es.L: Señor, conforme a todos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} actos de justicia, apártese ahora, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ruego, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ciudad Jerusalén, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo monte; porque por nuestros pecados y por las iniquidades de nuestros padres, Jerusalén y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo han sido hechos objeto de oprobio para todos los que nos rodean.
es.B: Señor, conforme a todos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} actos de justicia, aparta {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ciudad Jerusalén, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo monte. Por nuestros pecados y por las maldades de nuestros antepasados, Jerusalén y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo se han vuelto objeto de burla para todas las naciones que nos rodean.
es.R: Señor, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} siempre has hecho lo que es justo. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rogamos que dejes de estar enojado con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ciudad Jerusalén, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo monte. Por nuestros pecados y por los pecados de nuestros antepasados, todos los pueblos vecinos se burlan de Jerusalén y de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo.

sw.L: Ee Bwana, kwa kadiri ya matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yote ya haki, tafadhali hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na zigeuke kutoka mji {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Yerusalemu, mlima {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mtakatifu; kwa maana kwa sababu ya dhambi zetu na kwa sababu ya maovu ya baba zetu, Yerusalemu na watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wamekuwa aibu kwa wote wanaotuzunguka.
sw.B: Ee Bwana, kulingana na matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yote ya haki, igeuze hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mbali na mji {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Yerusalemu, mlima {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mtakatifu. Kwa sababu ya dhambi zetu na makosa ya mababu zetu, Yerusalemu na watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wamekuwa kitu cha dharau kwa mataifa yote yanayotuzunguka.
sw.R: Ee Bwana, siku zote umetenda yaliyo haki. Kwa hiyo tafadhali acha kuukasirikia mji {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Yerusalemu, mlima {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mtakatifu. Kwa sababu ya dhambi zetu na dhambi za mababu zetu, watu wote wanaotuzunguka wanaudhihaki Yerusalemu na watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

vi.L: Lạy Chúa, theo mọi việc công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin cho cơn giận và cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay khỏi thành Giê-ru-sa-lem của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì bởi tội lỗi chúng con và bởi các điều gian ác của tổ phụ chúng con, Giê-ru-sa-lem và dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành sự sỉ nhục cho mọi kẻ chung quanh chúng con.
vi.B: Lạy Chúa, xin theo mọi việc công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà dẹp cơn giận và cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi Giê-ru-sa-lem, thành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì tội lỗi chúng con và sự gian ác của tổ tiên chúng con mà Giê-ru-sa-lem và dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành trò sỉ nhục cho mọi dân chung quanh chúng con.
vi.R: Lạy Chúa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn làm điều công chính. Vậy xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thôi giận Giê-ru-sa-lem, thành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì tội lỗi của chúng con và tội lỗi của tổ tiên chúng con, mọi dân chung quanh chúng con đều chế giễu Giê-ru-sa-lem và dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님, 주님의 모든 의로운 일들대로, 제발 주님의 분노와 주님의 진노를 주님의 성읍 예루살렘, 주님의 거룩한 산에서 돌이키십시오. 저희의 죄와 저희 조상들의 죄악 때문에 예루살렘과 주님의 백성이 저희 주위의 모든 사람에게 조롱거리가 되었습니다.
ko.B: 주님, 주님께서 언제나 의로운 일을 행하셨으니, 주님의 성읍 예루살렘, 주님의 거룩한 산에서 주님의 분노와 진노를 거두어 주십시오. 저희의 죄와 저희 조상들의 잘못 때문에 예루살렘과 주님의 백성이 주위의 모든 민족에게 멸시를 받고 있습니다.
ko.R: 주님, 주님께서는 언제나 옳은 일을 하셨습니다. 그러니 제발 주님의 성읍 예루살렘, 주님의 거룩한 산에 더 이상 노하지 마십시오. 저희의 죄와 저희 조상들의 죄 때문에, 주위의 모든 사람이 예루살렘과 주님의 백성을 비웃고 있습니다.

am.L: ጌታ ሆይ፣ እንደ ጽድቅ ሥራህ ሁሉ ቁጣህና መዓትህ ከከተማህ ከኢየሩሳሌም፣ ከቅዱስ ተራራህ፣ እባክህ ይመለስ፤ ስለ ኃጢአታችንና ስለ አባቶቻችን በደል ኢየሩሳሌምና ሕዝብህ በዙሪያችን ላሉት ሁሉ መሰደቢያ ሆነዋልና።
am.B: ጌታ ሆይ፣ እንደ ጽድቅ ሥራህ ሁሉ ቁጣህንና መዓትህን ከከተማህ ከኢየሩሳሌም፣ ከቅዱስ ተራራህ መልስ። ከኃጢአታችንና ከአባቶቻችን በደል የተነሣ ኢየሩሳሌምና ሕዝብህ በዙሪያችን ላሉት ሕዝቦች ሁሉ መዘባበቻ ሆነዋል።
am.R: ጌታ ሆይ፣ አንተ ሁልጊዜ ትክክል የሆነውን አድርገሃል። ስለዚህ እባክህ በከተማህ በኢየሩሳሌም፣ በቅዱስ ተራራህ ላይ መቆጣትህን ተው። ከኃጢአታችንና ከአባቶቻችን ኃጢአት የተነሣ በዙሪያችን ያሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌምና በሕዝብህ ይሳለቃሉ።

hi.L: हे प्रभु, अपने सब धार्मिकता के कामों के अनुसार, कृपा करके अपना क्रोध और अपना कोप अपने नगर यरूशलेम, अपने पवित्र पर्वत पर से हटा ले; क्योंकि हमारे पापों के कारण और हमारे पितरों के अधर्म के कामों के कारण यरूशलेम और तेरी प्रजा हमारे चारों ओर के सब लोगों के बीच नामधराई का कारण बन गए हैं।
hi.B: हे प्रभु, अपने सब धार्मिकता के कामों के अनुसार अपना क्रोध और अपना रोष अपने नगर यरूशलेम से, अपने पवित्र पर्वत से हटा ले। हमारे पापों और हमारे पूर्वजों के दोषों के कारण यरूशलेम और तेरी प्रजा हमारे चारों ओर के सब देशों के लिए ठट्ठे का विषय बन गए हैं।
hi.R: हे प्रभु, तूने हमेशा वही किया है जो सही है। इसलिए कृपा करके अपने नगर यरूशलेम पर, अपने पवित्र पर्वत पर क्रोधित होना छोड़ दे। हमारे पापों और हमारे पूर्वजों के पापों के कारण हमारे आस-पास के सब लोग यरूशलेम का और तेरी प्रजा का मज़ाक़ उड़ाते हैं।

ru.L: Господь мой, по всем {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} праведным делам пусть отвратится, прошу, {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} гнев и {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} ярость от {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} города Иерусалима, {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} святой горы. Ведь за наши грехи и за беззакония наших отцов Иерусалим и {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ — в поношение всем, кто вокруг нас.
ru.B: Господи, по всем {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} праведным делам отврати свой гнев и свою ярость от {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} города Иерусалима, {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} святой горы. Из-за наших грехов и вины наших предков Иерусалим и {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ стали посмешищем для всех народов вокруг нас.
ru.R: Господи, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} всегда поступал праведно. Поэтому, пожалуйста, перестань гневаться на свой город Иерусалим, на свою святую гору. Из-за наших грехов и грехов наших предков все народы вокруг нас насмехаются над Иерусалимом и над {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} народом.

ja.L: 主よ、あなたのすべての正しいわざにしたがって、どうか、あなたの怒りとあなたの憤りを、あなたの町エルサレム、あなたの聖なる山から去らせてください。わたしたちの罪と、わたしたちの父祖たちの咎のために、エルサレムとあなたの民は、わたしたちの周りのすべての者のそしりとなっているからです。
ja.B: 主よ、あなたのすべての正しいわざにふさわしく、あなたの怒りと憤りを、あなたの町エルサレム、あなたの聖なる山から去らせてください。わたしたちの罪と先祖たちの悪のために、エルサレムとあなたの民は、周りのすべての国々のさげすみの的となっています。
ja.R: 主よ、あなたはいつも正しいことをしてこられました。ですから、どうか、あなたの町エルサレム、あなたの聖なる山に対して、もう怒らないでください。わたしたちの罪と、先祖たちの罪のために、周りの人々はみな、エルサレムとあなたの民をあざ笑っています。

decisions.choice: your righteous acts: the saving deeds that show God's righteousness
decisions.reason: The plural of "righteousness" means God's acts of righteousness, his saving deeds for his people (Judges 5:11; 1 Samuel 12:7; Micah 6:5). Daniel asks God to act now as he has acted before.

decisions.choice: your holy mountain: Mount Zion, where the temple stood
decisions.reason: Jerusalem and its temple mount are "your holy mountain" in the Psalms and prophets (Psalm 2:6; Isaiah 11:9; Joel 2:1).

decisions.choice: a disgrace to all around us: mocked by the neighboring nations
decisions.reason: The word means a reproach, an object of scorn (Psalm 79:4; Lamentations 5:1). The nations' mockery of Jerusalem dishonors the God whose city it is.

decisions.choice: righteous acts (L, B); you have always done what is right (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced say "righteous acts" for the plural (m1); Readable says it as a sentence.

decisions.choice: your (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: Daniel's prayer speaks to God as "you" and about him as "he"; every such pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting, except at the start of a sentence.

decisions.choice: "selon toutes tes justices" (L), "tes œuvres de justice" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew plural, which the meaning decision reads as God's saving deeds; Balanced names them as deeds.

decisions.choice: "의로운 일들" (L); "의로운 일" (B); "옳은 일" (R)
decisions.reason: The plural of tsedaqah means God's saving acts; Readable uses the plain word the term sheet sets for righteousness.

decisions.choice: "ira" and "furor" (L, B); "enojado" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for hemah ("furor" at L and B, "enojo" at R); R folds the pair into one verb as the English R does

decisions.choice: "धार्मिकता के कामों" (Literal, Balanced); "तूने हमेशा वही किया है जो सही है" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The plural "righteousnesses" means the saving deeds that show God's righteousness (m1); Readable says it as a sentence, as the English does. The holy mountain is Mount Zion (m2).

decisions.choice: tsidqotekha "正しいわざ" (L, B), "いつも正しいことをしてこられました" (R); har qodshekha "聖なる山"; cherpah "そしり" (L), "さげすみの的" (B), "あざ笑っています" (R)
decisions.reason: The saving deeds that show God's righteousness (m1); the holy mountain is Zion (m2); a disgrace among the neighbors (m3).

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀שְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְאֶל־תַּ֣חֲנוּנָ֔יו וְהָאֵ֣ר פָּנֶ֔יךָ עַל־מִקְדָּשְׁךָ֖ הַשָּׁמֵ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן אֲדֹנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And now listen, our God, to [the] prayer of your servant and to his supplications, and make shine your face on your sanctuary, the desolate, for [the] sake of [the] Lord.

en.L: And now listen, our God, to the prayer of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and to his pleas for mercy, and make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face shine upon {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sanctuary, which is desolate, for the Lord's sake.
en.B: Now, our God, listen to the prayer and the pleas of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant. For {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own sake, Lord, look with favor on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sanctuary, which lies in ruins.
en.R: Now, our God, listen to my prayer. I am {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant. Hear me as I beg {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for mercy. Lord, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own sake, be kind to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} temple, which lies in ruins.

pt.L: E agora ouve, nosso Deus, a oração do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo e as suas súplicas, e faz brilhar o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} rosto sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santuário, que está desolado, por amor do Senhor.
pt.B: Agora, nosso Deus, ouve a oração e as súplicas do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo. Por amor de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mesmo, Senhor, olha com bondade para o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santuário, que está em ruínas.
pt.R: Agora, nosso Deus, ouve a minha oração. Eu sou o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo. Ouve-me quando {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} peço misericórdia. Senhor, por amor de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mesmo, trata com bondade o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} templo, que está em ruínas.

fr.L: Et maintenant, écoute, notre Dieu, la prière de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et ses supplications, et fais briller {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} sanctuaire dévasté, à cause du Seigneur.
fr.B: Maintenant, notre Dieu, écoute la prière et les supplications de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur. Pour l’amour de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur, regarde avec bienveillance {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} sanctuaire qui est en ruine.
fr.R: Maintenant, notre Dieu, écoute ma prière. Je suis {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur. Écoute-moi quand je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} supplie d’avoir pitié. Seigneur, pour l’amour de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, sois bon envers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} temple qui est en ruine.

es.L: Y ahora escucha, Dios nuestro, la oración de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y sus súplicas, y haz resplandecer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro sobre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santuario, que está desolado, por amor del Señor.
es.B: Ahora, Dios nuestro, escucha la oración y los ruegos de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo. Por amor a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mismo, Señor, mira con favor {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santuario, que está en ruinas.
es.R: Ahora, Dios nuestro, escucha mi oración. Yo soy {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo. Escúchame mientras {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} suplico que tengas compasión. Señor, por amor a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mismo, sé bondadoso con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} templo, que está en ruinas.

sw.L: Basi sasa, Ee Mungu wetu, sikia maombi ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kusihi kwake, na uung'aze uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} juu ya patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}} palipo ukiwa, kwa ajili ya Bwana.
sw.B: Sasa, Ee Mungu wetu, sikia maombi na kusihi kwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mwenyewe, Bwana, uutazame kwa fadhili patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}, palipo magofu.
